Has anybody actually won as the rebels on this map?

TL:DR; It's possible. Just keep guarding one of the stations at least and keep pushing :D

Was in a party with one of my friends and we head into the playlist onto the Imperial side glee as one can be. We kinda figured that there was no possible way we could lose as the Rebels are simply overwhelmed. However as soon as we joined we were getting absolutely DESTROYED by the rebels fighting us. These guys had EIGHT Y-Wings ready to rain hell down onto our ATAT. Once they finished attacking our ATAT was at minuscule health and we scrambled to assist out teammates and turn the tide.

However once we left that game showed us one thing, it is possible to win as the Rebels.

So we hop onto a playlist and were determined to try to win a game as we believed that we could. My partner and I managed to spend most of the time defending one station but went back causally here and there to activate a second one. This was so that we could throw the Imperials for a loop as they;d now have two places to attack. Once the time came we'd pray to find power ups like shields and Smart Rockets to do some damage or defend us while we hold down an area.

When we saw those big elephants come to a collapse there never felt such gratification in my time during this beta.

Like I said, defend your stations, find power ups, shield up here and there to draw fire from teammates and you can win man! :D

I've seen it happen once out of 6-7 games. The Rebels have to A) Get at least 4, preferably many more, Y-Wings per round and B) maintain total air superiority, preventing all Imperial air support and launching insanely successful runs against the AT-ATs every opening, bombing the Empire's AT-STs and preventing the capture of the uplinks in between.

It's a fun and neat battle mode, but is completely tilted in favor of the Empire in nearly every way, especially with them having vehicles and the Rebels having very little in the way to dispatch them; It seriously needs to be balanced better.
